In the previous session the user asked about Q2 revenue trends and margin compression. The assistant confirmed gross margin fell 3 pp to 41 percent due to supply chain costs.

Q3 Financial Report — Revenue 4.2 M up 12 percent YoY. Operating costs 3.1 M. EBITDA 1.1 M margin 26 percent. Headcount grew from 48 to 61. Cash position 2.3 M end of quarter. Inventory turns improved to 8.4 from 7.1. Accounts receivable days outstanding 38. Capital expenditure 0.4 M primarily infrastructure. Board approved 0.5 M share buyback programme commencing Q4.

Q4 Forecast — Projected revenue 4.8 M driven by two enterprise contracts signed in October worth a combined 0.9 M annualised. Pipeline coverage ratio 3.2 x. Marketing spend increasing 20 percent to support two product launches. Hiring plan adds 14 engineers and 4 sales staff. Expected gross margin recovery to 44 percent as supply chain normalises. CFO flagged FX headwind of approximately 0.15 M if sterling weakens further. Scenario analysis: bear case 4.3 M revenue at 22 percent EBITDA margin, base 4.8 M at 26 percent, bull 5.4 M at 29 percent. Board risk register updated to include concentration risk from top-three customers representing 58 percent of ARR.
